summary: Implemented the feature without committing. New: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver), monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), and plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Changed: nifti_writer default dtype to np.float32; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler are now thin adapters over the savers and plot function (output_dir, filename, and index parameters added per spec). Callers updated: two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; classification test passes filename. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Verification was by reading only: no lines over 120 characters and correct file endings. Tests and flake8 were not run, so ignite 0.3.0 handler registration and nibabel dtype assertions are unverified.
